zones.label: Learn
zones.summary: Technology can support learning when a trusted adult approves the activity.
facts: Use apps and sites a trusted adult knows about.
Learning tools should not ask a young child to share private details alone.
Tell an adult if anything feels confusing or uncomfortable.

zones.label: Play
zones.summary: Healthy technology use balances screen play with movement, rest, and people.
facts: Approved games can be one enjoyable activity.
Bodies also need active play and sleep.
A trusted adult can help choose when to stop.

zones.label: Private Information
zones.summary: Names, addresses, schools, phone numbers, and photos should not be shared without permission.
facts: Pause when a screen asks for personal details.
Do not type an answer just because a form appears.
Private information belongs to the child and family.

zones.label: Ask an Adult
zones.summary: When unsure, stop and bring the device to a trusted adult.
facts: Asking is a smart safety action.
Show the adult what appeared on screen.
A trusted adult can help close, report, or choose safely.

quiz.question: Which panel shows an adult-approved school activity?
Which panel reminds us that screens are only one part of a balanced day?
Which panel includes details such as a name, address, school, or photo?
Which panel is the best choice whenever you are unsure?
